name: Bidar

queries.query: Bidar Karnataka official cadastral parcel map land records GIS site:gov.in
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Bidar District Government of Karnataka Land Records page, which links to Karnataka Bhoomi/land-record services and states that present/old RTC and mutation extracts can be viewed by survey number. It also found the DILRMP Bidar map-digitization/ULPIN status pages and the current national NAKSHA portal. No anonymous Bidar parcel feature response was returned by discovery.

queries.query: ಬೀದರ್ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಭೂ ದಾಖಲೆ ಜಿಐಎಸ್ ಪಾರ್ಸೆಲ್ ನಕ್ಷೆ
queries.result: First-party Kannada discovery found the Kannada Bidar District Government of Karnataka Land Records page, linking to the Karnataka land-record portal and describing current/old RTC and mutation-extract access by survey number. It also found the Kannada district revenue/administrative pages, but no public Bidar parcel polygon response.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Kannada first-party discovery, followed by bounded anonymous TLS-verified GET requests. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Bidar District Government of Karnataka page identifies Bidar DC Office as the local custodian context and links to the official Karnataka land-record service for survey-number RTC and mutation-extract viewing. It does not expose parcel geometry in the page response.
Official Kannada Bidar District land-record page with the same Bhoomi/land-record service link and survey-number RTC/mutation description.
Official DILRMP Bidar status page reports cadastral-map digitization, geo-referencing and ULPIN-related status. This is programme/status evidence, not an open parcel feature service.
Official NAKSHA viewer. Its current JavaScript configuration exposed the Karnataka state parcel service URL, EPSG:32643 and a FeatureServer query route, but the route required a token anonymously.

requests.assessment: Anonymous TLS-verified request timed out after 25 seconds. No Bhoomi viewer configuration, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was obtained. This is not evidence of cadastral absence.

Viewer HTML and current JavaScript/configuration were retrieved. Configuration identified the Karnataka NAKSHA parcel service at https://nakshagis.dolr.gov.in/utm4243/rest/services/Naksha_43/Naksha_ka_29_43/FeatureServer/0, with EPSG:32643 and a /query route.
ArcGIS service metadata returned {error:{code:499,message:'Token Required'}}. No anonymous schema or feature response was available.
Bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry query around the exact WUP point (transformed only for the request to EPSG:32643) returned Token Required. No polygon was retained; no hit/miss inference was made.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bidar district local land-record custody, Karnataka Bhoomi survey-number services, DILRMP cadastral status, and the current NAKSHA Karnataka parcel service configuration.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry custody and programme/viewer configuration were verified, but no anonymous Bidar parcel geometry coverage was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The Bhoomi service's current route/schema and the NAKSHA token-gated service's accessible authorization path, parcel schema, native identity, citywide coverage and update currency remain unresolved. The exact WUP point [17.9093292688742, 77.5145528508122] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted. Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial qualification.
